description: Student-style questions over corpus.json. Each expected item names a document, a 1-based page and an evidence span quoted verbatim from that page: a retrieved chunk supports the question only if it contains the span. match=all needs every span in the top k (multi-passage questions). Category out_of_corpus has no answer in the corpus and is excluded from recall; it is kept for the evidence-sufficiency work.
